reflections.title: "Increase and Overflow with Love"

reflect.text: God calls us to let His love pour out into the lives of people around us. Through salvation, He has already blessed us with an abundance of grace. When we share that goodness through small, spontaneous acts of kindness, we encourage others and set off a chain reaction of joy. Genuine Christian love does not stop with people who look or think like us. It stretches out to reach everyone, even when it is not easy.

Loving like this is not something we earn or produce on our own. It is the Holy Spirit at work within us. We depend on God to soften our hard hearts and fill us with His love. Turning to gratitude during daily annoyances helps us stay close to Him in prayer. As we actively seek ways to refresh others, our lives become an open testimony of Christ to the world.

questions: Who is someone different from you that you can encourage with a small act of kindness today?
How can choosing to be thankful during daily frustrations help you show love to others?
reflections.prayer: Lord, thank You for blessing us so generously through salvation. Soften our hearts when we face frustration, and let Your Spirit cause our love to overflow to everyone around us. Help us refresh someone today so that our lives point to Jesus. Amen.
